svg.title: AC9E1LA01 — Common mix-ups and quick check
svg.desc: Words only. Try instead: Also notice face, gesture, voice and relationship. Command instead of request. Try instead: Use polite wording when asking someone to do something. One voice for every purpose. Try instead: Change volume, tone or gesture to match meaning. Which sentence is a question? Turn “Give me the book” into a polite request. What facial expression might match an exclamation? Why does relationship matter when we speak?
